verdict.rationale: Homebrew's manpage documents a first-party opt-out, `brew analytics off`, which turns off its anonymous aggregate user-behaviour analytics. The GitHub repo confirms those analytics are collected and published at formulae.brew.sh/analytics, so the opt-out applies to real data collection. missing for 10: documentation of exactly what data is collected and what the opt-out stops, an environment-variable or config opt-out for non-interactive/agent/CI use, independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out works.
